capabilities: Render an animated Matrix-style rain background
Adjust theme colors and transparency to match the rain
Toggle the background via a command palette command
disambiguation: Not a theming engine; it overlays one animated rain effect and adjusts colors to match, leaving your selected theme in place.
extras: Tested mainly on macOS with Default and Minimal themes; other themes and platforms may vary. Windows users must enable OS animation effects or the rain stays still. Plugin makes no network requests and reads no notes.
problem: Obsidian's interface has a plain, static background with no option for an animated decorative backdrop that matches the theme.
summary: Visual decoration plugin that shows an animated Matrix-style falling-code rain behind the interface and adjusts theme colors and transparency to match.
